product.name: Home Construction Services
product.description: End-to-end residential construction services including independent houses, duplexes, villas, bungalows, farmhouses, and custom homes.

product.name: Commercial Construction Services
product.description: Construction services for commercial properties including PG/rental housing, schools, hotels, offices, and warehousing.

product.name: Building Materials Supply
product.description: Online platform to purchase construction materials including cement, steel, tiles, sanitary ware, and more with guaranteed on-time delivery.

product.description: An online tool to estimate the cost of constructing precast compound walls based on dimensions and location.
